verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships several first-party background automations. Patterns runs its Loop agent over the trace backlog on a schedule, online scoring evaluates production traces asynchronously as they are logged, and Topics continuously classifies traces. These are fixed-purpose background jobs rather than a general, user-defined automation builder, and how much they can be configured is thinly documented. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/workflow builder with user-defined triggers and actions, documentation of schedule configuration and controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Patterns puts Loop to work on your trace backlog on a schedule.
Online scoring evaluates production traces automatically as they’re logged, running asynchronously with no impact on latency.
Topics continuously clusters every trace against them.
Topics automatically analyze and classify your logs without manual review.
